description: Lua-defined extensions set up by the secure preinit script. The preinit also pulls a curated subset of the GMod API into the secure state's global environment via lje.secure.pull (e.g. ents, render, surface, timer, util, Vector, LocalPlayer, ...), registers class metatables in the registry, and installs a few polyfills.

constants.name: lje.includeCache
constants.description: A per-script cache used by `lje.require`. Keyed by script name, then by path. Populated automatically — you generally do not need to interact with this directly.

constants.name: hook
constants.description: A minimal replacement for GMod's hook library, defined in the secure state. `hook.Add(event, identifier, func)` registers a listener; `hook.Listen()` installs an engine call hook (via `lje.vm.set_engine_call_hook`) that dispatches engine events to the registered listeners; `hook.Call` is a no-op. Listener return values are not supported yet.

constants.name: cam.Start2D
constants.description: A polyfill for GMod's `cam.Start2D`, implemented on top of the pulled `cam.Start` function.

constants.name: cam.Start3D
constants.description: A polyfill for GMod's `cam.Start3D`, implemented on top of the pulled `cam.Start` function.

functions.name: require
functions.description: A cached version of `lje.include`. The first call for a given `path` within a script context executes the file and caches the result. Subsequent calls return the cached value immediately. Must be called within an active script context.

params.name: path
params.description: Path to the file to include, relative to the current script.

returns.description: The return value of the included file, or the cached result from a prior call.

functions.name: con_printf
functions.description:
A `string.format`-style console print with inline ANSI color support. Wrap text in `$colorName{...}` to colorize it.

Supported colors: `black`, `red`, `green`, `yellow`, `blue`, `magenta`, `cyan`, `white`, `default`.

Example:
```lua
lje.con_printf("$red{Error}: %s", message)
```

params.name: fmt
params.description: A `string.format` format string. Color codes use the syntax `$colorName{text}`.

functions.name: con_success
functions.description: A helper function which prints the given message as a success into the LJE console.

functions.name: con_error
functions.description: A helper function which prints the given message as an error into the LJE console.

functions.name: con_warn
functions.description: A helper function which prints the given message as a warning into the LJE console.
